title: Directors releasing within two years
statementMd:
Directors who released two movies at most two calendar years apart (the second one 1 or 2 years after the first). Show name and the earliest such first release year as first_year.

Expected columns: `name`, `first_year`.

Tables: `directors`, `movies`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Self-join movies on the same director with `b.release_year BETWEEN a.release_year + 1 AND a.release_year + 2`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.name, MIN(a.release_year) AS first_year FROM movies a JOIN movies b ON b.director_id = a.director_id AND b.release_year BETWEEN a.release_year + 1 AND a.release_year + 2 JOIN directors d ON d.id = a.director_id GROUP BY d.id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
